correctness.rationale: The complete two-sided global proof uses the exact Lie derivative \(\dot\Phi=z^2-(1+b)y^2\). At \(b\leq-1\) the zero-derivative invariant set is precisely the equilibrium plane, giving strict monotonicity, limit sets and invariant-measure support; time-integrating gives the exact heteroclinic budget. For \(b>-1\), the periodic zero-mean y and Wirtinger inequality yield \(T\geq 2\pi/\sqrt{1+b}\), with equality contradicted by \(\dot z=w(y-az)\), considering \(a=0\) separately. The included symbolic checker independently validates all critical polynomial identities. No existence, global boundedness or optimal-infimum statement is claimed.

value.rationale: The explicit half-line \(b\leq-1\) exclusion of all nonequilibrium recurrence is a global qualitative phase-space theorem for a natural 4D system with a nonisolated equilibrium plane; bounded orbit limits and stationary measures are classified. On the complementary side a strict period barrier with divergence at the same energy-sign boundary constrains any oscillatory branch. These infinite-time facts are neither finite table lookups nor normalization identities and are not implied by the original numerical figures. No existence threshold or global chaos boundary is asserted.
